selection: Explicit post-169 two-window W12 baseline export; not a private repository or history import.

provenance.raw_extraction: Original complete CRC-framed streams validated by saved-only analyzers. Raw streams remain private and are unavailable for public reconstruction.
provenance.transformation: All selected 600 W12 PPS, 600 downstream PPS, 120 sampled TX and GNSS-prediction rows retained in original order per window. Replace source identities with stable source-A/source-B aliases; omit factory/boot/group/session identities, absolute UTC/counters, USB paths, credentials and unrelated console/status records. Publish signed phase/residuals, eligibility, failure reasons and frozen adjustments. No outliers removed or offsets refitted.
provenance.review: Selected numerical exports reviewed for public publication on 24 October 2026; hardware-observation evidence, not calibrated UTC certification.
